footer.tagline: A landmark of luxury hospitality on the shores of the Red Sea — where timeless elegance meets unforgettable experiences in Gardens Bay, Sharm El Sheikh.

about.title: About
about.metaDesc: A landmark of Red Sea hospitality since 1991 — 35 years of refined luxury in Gardens Bay, Sharm El Sheikh.
about.ogDesc: Our story, our values, our promise.
about.heroTitle: A landmark of the Red Sea
about.heroSubtitle: Since 1991, a quiet pioneer of luxury in Sharm El Sheikh.
about.storyP1: Park Regency opened its doors in 1991 as one of the first true luxury resorts on the Sinai Peninsula. Three decades on, we remain family-owned — guided by the same belief that quietly excellent service is the rarest luxury of all.
about.storyP2: Today, Park Regency stretches across 22 hectares of beachfront in Gardens Bay, with 344 rooms and suites, three private beaches, seven restaurants and a flagship conference center.

values.intuitiveServiceText: We anticipate, never interrupt. Service felt, never seen.
values.craftsmanshipText: From the brick of our archways to the plating of every course.
values.sustainabilityText: A working reef-conservation programme and 100% renewable energy by 2030.
values.communityText: Eighty percent of our team is from the Sinai region we proudly call home.

attractions.title: Local Attractions & Excursions — Park Regency Sharm El Sheikh
attractions.metaDesc: Explore the best of Sharm El Sheikh. From the world-famous dive sites of Ras Mohammed to desert safaris and historical monasteries.
attractions.heroSubtitle: Venture beyond the resort gates to discover spectacular reef systems, rich histories, and vibrant entertainment hubs.

gardensBay.title: Gardens Bay Private Beach
gardensBay.desc: Our private three-tier beach offers soft sands, private cabanas, and immediate reef entry. Widely regarded as Sharm El Sheikh's most tranquil cove.

rasMohammed.title: Ras Mohammed National Park
rasMohammed.desc: Ranked among the top ten dive sites globally. Explore vertical coral walls, shipwrecks, and shark observatories with legendary marine biodiversity.

tiran.title: Straits of Tiran
tiran.desc: Home to four dramatic reef systems (Jackson, Woodhouse, Thomas, Gordon) rising from deep water, attracting turtles, barracuda, and hammerheads.

bedouinSpa.title: Bedouin Desert Spa Stargazing
bedouinSpa.desc: An authentic desert wellness experience. Enjoy hot sand therapy, customized oil massage in private luxury tents, and traditional Bedouin herbal tea under the stars.

lagoon.title: Gardens Bay Lagoon Complex
lagoon.desc: Our landmark multi-level lagoon features high waterfalls, a cave pool, lazy river channels, and separate quiet zones for premium adult relaxation.

soho.title: Soho Square Sharm El Sheikh
soho.desc: A premier entertainment, shopping, and dining hub. Features high-end boutiques, ice skating, dancing fountains, and international restaurants.

naama.title: Naama Bay Water Park
naama.desc: A massive kids-friendly water park featuring over 30 slides, splash grounds, wave pools, and dedicated dining zones perfect for a full family day out.

golf.title: Jolie Ville Championship Golf Course
golf.desc: An 18-hole par 72 championship golf course set amidst artificial lakes, offering spectacular mountain ranges and Red Sea vistas.

faqs.title: FAQs — Park Regency Sharm El Sheikh
faqs.metaDesc: Answers to the most common questions about your stay — check-in, transfers, kids, pets, Wi-Fi and parking.
faqs.heroSubtitle: Everything you need to know before your stay.

items.q1: What are your check-in and check-out times?
items.a1: Check-in from 14:00, check-out by 12:00. Early check-in and late check-out are available subject to occupancy and may be complimentary for Regency Club guests.
items.a2: Yes — private chauffeur transfers from Sharm El Sheikh International Airport (SSH) can be arranged for $45 per car (one-way). Please request 48 hours in advance.
items.a3: Children of all ages are welcome. Kids under 6 stay free in their parents' room; ages 6–12 receive a 50% discount. A complimentary kids' club operates daily for ages 4–12.
items.a4: We are not able to accommodate pets at the resort, with the exception of registered service animals.
items.a5: Yes — complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the resort.
items.a6: Yes — complimentary self-parking and valet parking are available for all guests.
items.a7: Yes, our front desk offers exchange for major currencies. We also accept USD, EUR, GBP, EGP and SAR.
items.a8: Cancellations made at least 7 days prior to arrival are fully refundable. Non-refundable rates are clearly marked at the time of booking.
items.a9: Yes, reservations can be modified up to 7 days before arrival. Please contact our reservations team for changes.
